decisions.meaning: Use next-day plus 5/10/20-session formal forecast points; retain 3/6/12-month forecasts and separate 3–5-year scenarios. Quote/risk cadence stays 30 minutes where eligible. Exact monthly roll, targets, model catalogue and eligibility policies remain open.

decisions.answer: Calendar months; roll back to valid date
decisions.meaning: 3/6/12-month forecasts use calendar-month anniversaries, rolling back to the preceding valid session or valuation date when closed. Score only when canonical target-date value is available. This does not choose exact origin cutoffs, publication lag policy, thresholds or numerical model parameters.
